output.one_liner: Klaviyo is a customer platform for email, SMS and push marketing.

auth.notes: Private API keys (server-side) and public keys (client-side) for direct API calls; OAuth for public marketplace apps.

evidence.snippet: Create a private API key and make your first call to the Klaviyo API in a few minutes.

access.notes: Private API keys available immediately after account creation for Owner/Admin/Manager roles. OAuth apps require app review for marketplace listing. Sandbox accounts available linked to production login.

evidence.snippet: Creating an API key takes an Owner, Admin or Manager role on the account.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Per-account with burst (1-second) and steady (1-minute) windows; standard endpoints: 350/s burst, 3500/m steady.

evidence.snippet: you can download the OpenAPI spec the reference is generated from.
All new API endpoints are rate limited on a per-account basis, and use a fixed-window rate limiting algorithm.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve private credentials, comprehensive REST API with OpenAPI spec, official MCP support, and existing Composio toolkit with 233 tools already built.

overview_evidence.snippet: Klaviyo is a customer platform for email, SMS and push marketing, built on the data your customers create.
